title: Malaysia API
blurb: A static REST API of Malaysian states and federal territories. JSON files, no database, on purpose.

title: AITA store
blurb: A Reddit crawler, SQLite store, and dashboard for r/AmItheAsshole. Sentiment, word clouds, later FastAPI.

title: Sentiment analysis
blurb: Browser-only sentiment with AFINN, VADER, NRC, Bing, and Loughran-McDonald. No node_modules.

title: D3 Word Cloud Generator
blurb: A browser word cloud built on D3. Point it at text, get a layout.

title: Robogo
blurb: A YAML test automation tool in Go for HTTP, databases, Kafka, and SWIFT. KISS, no loops, no secret store.

title: Call Log to Calendar
blurb: Android app that pushes call logs to Google Calendar.
